__comment: Display copied verbatim from vanilla heavy_core (same 8³ geometry) so the item renders the same size; undefined contexts fall back to identity exactly as heavy_core does. No block/block parent — its smaller display would otherwise apply. World/entity rendering ignores display.
__comment2: Texture sheet lead_weight.png is split into four 8x8 regions: sides [0,0..8,8], top [8,0..16,8], bottom [0,8..8,16], nub-side [8,8..16,16]. The four orb sides share one region; nub up shares the top region.

elements.__comment: 8x8x8 lead ball on the ground, centred.
4x4x2 nub centred on the orb's top (the chain anchor). No down face: it sits flush on the orb. Sides sample the nub-side region; up shares the top region.
